predictions.articleTitle: Corinthians vs Botafogo Prediction & Match Analysis: Garro & Yuri Alberto Out — xG & Scoreline Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Botafogo are projected to avoid defeat (Draw / Away Win) in a tight 1:1 or 1:2 contest as Corinthians absorb severe spine absences across attack, midfield, and defense.
possibilityAssessment: Draw / Away Win — Botafogo avoid defeat led by a 1:1 stalemate, supported by superior 1.26 season xG and 51.0 MF-OTI against depleted hosts (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Under 2.5 Goals & BTTS: Yes — 1:1 convergence reflects Corinthians' 62.5% home Under 2.5 rate offset by Botafogo's 7.1% away clean-sheet record (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
1:2 Botafogo Breakthrough — Secondary script if relegation urgency stretches Corinthians after 60 minutes for Ziyech and Danilo Santos to exploit (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Depleted Corinthians spine faces porous Botafogo road defense in relegation clash.

spf.comment: Covers both the modal 1:1 stalemate and a 1:2 Botafogo breakthrough, as Corinthians' five confirmed outfield absences outweigh single-win confidence while Botafogo's 7.1% away clean-sheet rate prevents isolating an away win.

over_under.comment: Backed by a 51.8% Poisson under baseline, Corinthians' 62.5% home Under 2.5 profile, and the loss of Garro and Yuri Alberto curbing home goal volume.

btts.comment: Aligned with 52.9% Poisson BTTS probability and 1.75 market pricing as Botafogo's 7.1% away clean-sheet rate meets a Corinthians backline missing Andre Ramalho.

score.comment: 1:1 is the top Poisson convergence point (12.6%) given mutual scoring floors and home creative losses, while 1:2 captures late away quality if hosts overcommit.

goals.comment: 2 goals (25.1% Poisson) and 3 goals (21.8% Poisson) anchor the narrow-margin 1:1 and 1:2 scoring scenarios.

bqc.comment: Corinthians' 50.0% half-time draw rate at home points to a level first half before settling at 1:1 or breaking toward a second-half Botafogo win (66.7% away HT-draw-to-win rate).
